responsibility: Shared builtin-numbering header for the BRIG frontend that defines the frontend’s enums for builtin attributes and builtin type signatures by re-expanding GCC’s `builtin-attrs.def` and `builtin-types.def`. These enum IDs are the stable index space used by `brig-lang.c` and the instruction handlers when registering BRIG/HSAIL builtin functions and looking up their GCC tree types.
